transcript.answer: I found no p99 latency SLO defined specifically for the /api/context route. The GET /api/context spec (specs/api-routes/context/spec.md) has no latency target. The nearest targets are broader ones. The platform spec says context search should return in under 200ms (p99). It marks that target as aspirational and says it hadn't been benchmarked as of 2026-03-28. The retrieval-benchmarks spec sets alert thresholds of 200ms p95 for search and 500ms for lore_assemble_context. The context-assembly spec says assembly latency should stay under 500ms. None of these names the /api/context route, so I can't confirm a route-specific p99 SLO.

judgements.reason: The answer says no p99 latency SLO is defined for the /api/context route, which matches the gold answer; the broader targets it cites are explicitly noted as not naming that route, so they do not contradict the gold.
